verdict.rationale: cfo.ai is a SaaS financial-planning platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no cfo.ai command-line tool. The `claude mcp add` command belongs to Claude Code, a host client, and the MCP server and skill.md are a different capability; neither counts as an official cfo.ai CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
